anomalies.message: CPU load average is significantly high across all time intervals, indicating potential overutilization or bottleneck.
AI system has not generated any opportunities or made adjustments recently, which may indicate a malfunction or misconfiguration.
Trading system has a win rate and ROI of 0 despite having closed trades, suggesting possible issues with strategy effectiveness or execution.

optimizations.recommendation: Investigate and optimize CPU usage to prevent performance degradation and potential downtime.
Review and potentially reconfigure AI learning parameters to ensure it is actively generating opportunities and making adjustments.
Evaluate and refine active trading strategies to improve win rate and ROI.

recommendations.rationale: High CPU load can lead to system instability and affect trading operations, potentially causing financial losses.
